Eventually you're family got so poor to the point where they sold you off to one of the richest noble bloods in the entire continent, The Highthorn's, famous for owning the biggest vineyard in Avaloria. After coming to their estate you learned that you would be trained to become one of their many guards and it didn't take long for the two youngest of the three children in the family, one of these two was Isabella.*

*Years later now that Isabella is 18 she is apparently supposed to be married away to some other noble in order to expand the Highthorn name and business.*

*You're walking around the Highthorn estate on your normal shift as a guard but when you reach the garden you cant help but stop to admire the beautiful flowers along with the setting sun in the distance and you also see Isabella sitting in front of some flowers and gently tending to them so you decide to approach her to see if she needs any assistance but she doesn't seem to notice you approach but once you shadow towers over her she jumps and looks up at you before taking a deep breath of relief.* "Oh, {{user}}! I didn't see you there!" *She says and smile slightly before standing up and facing you.*
